source_title: JOIA Rose Hall Undergoes Full Renovation, Bringing a New Expression of Jamaican Luxury to Montego Bay
source_excerpt:
The adults-only, all-inclusive beachfront resort returns December 1 with redesigned accommodations, elevated dining and experiences rooted in Jamaican culture.
MONTEGO BAY, Jamaica , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- JOIA Rose Hall , Iberostar Group's luxury, adults-only, all-inclusive beachfront resort in Montego Bay, Jamaica, will welcome guests back on December 1, 2026, following a full renovation. The transformation marks a new chapter for the brand's JOIA luxury collection segment, introducing reimagined interiors and guest experiences that celebrate the culture, character and natural beauty of the destination.
Located along Montego Bay's Rose Hall Corridor, approximately 10 miles from Sangster International Airport, the resort's redesign was developed in collaboration with award-winning architecture and interior design firm El Equipo Creativo . The design blends tropical influences with natural textures, lush landscaping and locally inspired details to create a contemporary retreat with a distinctly Jamaican character.
A renovation that goes beyond the ordinary The renovation brings a renewed look to the resort's arrival areas, lobby, staircase, solarium, poolside terraces and beachfront spaces. Inspired by the golden age of travel, the redesign blends local textures, vibrant patterns, and effortless eleganceto create a warm, joyful, and immersive luxury experience. The resort's 295 suites, including Butler Suites, Swim-up Suites and Penthouse Suites, have also been reimagined as private retreats featuring eclectic furnishings, locally inspired patterns and private terraces. Twenty-four-hour room service adds another layer of personalized comfort.
"JOIA Rose Hall represents an exciting expression of our vision for luxury hospitality in the Caribbean," said Antonio Bauza, Global Brand Communications Director at Iberostar. "This renovation goes beyond refreshing a resort. It is about creating a more distinctive sense of place, where contemporary design, authentic Jamaican character and thoughtful service come together to align with the brand's genuine hospitality standards. We look forward to welcoming guests back to discover a new chapter for JOIA Rose Hall."
A new expression of Jamaican hospitality Jamaican culture and personalized service are central to the renewed guest experience. Along the resort's stretch of beach, a dedicated Pool Concierge will offer personalized service and thoughtful touches, from chilled rum cocktails to poolside dominoes and music-led experiences.
Guests can enjoy four swimming pools, including an infinity pool ideal for sunset views. The Caribbean Sea provides opportunities for kayaking, catamaran sailing, snorkeling, or windsurfing. Additional amenities include Spa Sensations, a fully equipped Fit & Fun gym, an outdoor running trail, tennis, pickleball, golf, a turfed football field and a dive center. Meeting facilities also offer spaces for gatherings and special events in a beachfront setting.
"Our goal is for guests to feel the spirit of Jamaica from the moment they arrive," said Thomas van Balveren, General Manager at JOIA Rose Hall. "The refreshed resort brings together beautiful surroundings, thoughtful details and warm, personal service. Whether guests are enjoying the beach, discovering new culinary experiences or simply taking time to unwind, we want every moment to feel effortless, meaningful and connected to the island."
Culinary discovery, crafted cocktails and the rhythm of Jamaica Dining is central to the JOIA Rose Hall experience, where an exceptional collection of restaurants and bars blends international culinary artistry with the vibrant spirit of Jamaica. Featuring nine dining venues, including five specialty restaurants, and four bars.
At its heart is Oriole, the signature beachfront restaurant celebrating authentic Jamaican classics and Caribbean flavors in a setting that captures the island's rich culinary heritage. The experience extends to GAIA House of Grill, showcasing premium cuts and refined grilled specialties; Chez Charlie, offering a contemporary take on French brasserie dining; and ZÃ¡zÃ¡, where chef Erik Bruner-Yang's collaboration brings a distinctive perspective to the bold flavors of Southeast Asia, infused with the energy of the Caribbean.
The Palm Tropical Lounge offers a refined, tropical interpretation of the classic hotel bar, adding another distinctive dimension to the resort's culinary and social scene. Complemented by Mediterranean-inspired dining, sophisticated lounges and the immersive cultural experience of the Rum Bar & Theatre, JOIA Rose Hall offers a distinctive culinary journey defined by global influences, memorable settings and the warmth of Jamaican hospitality.
The resort's cocktail program will be led by award-winning mixology partner Giacomo Giannotti, whose bar in Barcelona, Paradiso, is recognized among The World's 50 Best Bars. Giannotti will bring the island's spirit and character to life through a thoughtfully crafted botanical cocktail menu, which spotlights a signature cocktail with sorrel as the main ingredient, ensuring a root-to-stem philosophy.
The property's musical offering will connect guests with Jamaica's vibrant creative culture. Under the direction of JOIA Music Curator, Soledad RodrÃ­guez, specially designed music tracks will shape the ambiance throughout the resort, complemented by live performances and nightly entertainment featuring local artists and celebrating the island's music, dance and traditions.
JOIA Rose Hall is part of the strategic alliance between Iberostar Beachfront Resorts and IHG Hotels & Resorts, giving IHG One Rewards members the opportunity to earn points on qualifying stays, redeem points for Reward Nights and enjoy eligible on-property benefits. The resort is also available to book through IHG.com.

About JOIA Rose Hall JOIA Rose Hall is a luxury, adults-only, all-inclusive beachfront resort located along Montego Bay's renowned Rose Hall Corridor in Jamaica. Part of Iberostar Group's JOIA luxury portfolio, the resort features 295 suites, nine specialty restaurants and a collection of bars offering diverse culinary experiences, alongside extensive wellness, recreational and entertainment amenities. Following a full renovation developed in collaboration with award-winning design firm Equipo Creativo, JOIA Rose Hall blends contemporary design with tropical influences and authentic Jamaican character. Guests can enjoy personalized service, curated music experiences, locally inspired cocktails and a range of beach and watersport activities along the Caribbean coast. The resort is part of the Iberostar Rose Hall Resort Complex, alongside Iberostar Selection Rose Hall Suites and Iberostar Waves Rose Hall Beach, and is scheduled to welcome guests back on December 1, 2026. Learn more at iberostar.com/en/hotels/montego-bay/joia-rose-hall-by-iberostar .
About the Iberostar Group Iberostar Beachfront Resorts is the hotel division and core business of Iberostar Group, a 100% family-owned Spanish multinational with 70 years of history in tourism, with its business origins dating back to 1877. Its portfolio features 26,800 rooms across more than 80 four- and five-star hotels in 13 countries, dedicated to delivering exceptional quality and heartfelt service. Iberostar Wave of Change, its movement to drive responsible change, is applied through seven integrated areas - supporting environmental and social impact inside the company, within its destinations and across the sector.
Welcoming 2.5 million guests annually and boasting a prime beachfront presence, the Iberostar Beachfront Resorts brand offers three distinct segments to fulfill every traveler's holiday dreams. Iberostar Waves delivers fun-filled experiences, perfect for families and couples who love the beach. Iberostar Selection provides premium, spacious, and relaxing stays with exceptional service. Lastly, JOIA a collection of luxury resorts in exclusive locations, distinguished by highly personalized and refined service.
